+import { Controller } from "@hotwired/stimulus"
+
+// Officer-facing location picker: search -> pin on map -> drag/click to adjust,
+// or choose from a saved list. Writes latitude/longitude into hidden fields and
+// a readable name into the visible location field. Leaflet is loaded globally (L).
+export default class extends Controller {
+  static targets = ["query", "results", "status", "map", "mapFrame", "mapError",
+                    "fullscreenButton", "fullscreenStatus",
+                    "latitude", "longitude", "name", "saved"]
+  static values = {
+    searchUrl: String,
+    noResultsMessage: String,
+    mapErrorMessage: String,
+    searchErrorMessage: String,
+    missingLocationMessage: String,
+    missingNameMessage: String,
+    defaultLat: { type: Number, default: 39.8283 },
+    defaultLng: { type: Number, default: -98.5795 },
+    defaultZoom: { type: Number, default: 4 },
+    pinZoom: { type: Number, default: 17 }
+  }
+
+  connect() {
+    this.autoNamed = false
+    this.timer = null
+    this.initMap()
+  }
+
+  disconnect() {
+    if (this.fullscreen) this.exitFullscreen()
+    clearTimeout(this.timer)
+    this.searchAbort?.abort()
+    this.reverseAbort?.abort()
+    this.destroyMap()
+  }
+
+  // ---- map ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+  initMap() {
+    try {
+      if (typeof L === "undefined") throw new Error("Leaflet did not load")
+
+      const lat = parseFloat(this.latitudeTarget.value)
+      const lng = parseFloat(this.longitudeTarget.value)
+      const hasPoint = Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng)
+
+      this.map = L.map(this.mapTarget).setView(
+        hasPoint ? [lat, lng] : [this.defaultLatValue, this.defaultLngValue],
+        hasPoint ? this.pinZoomValue : this.defaultZoomValue
+      )
+
+      let loaded = 0
+      let failed = 0
+      const tiles = L.tileLayer("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
+        maxZoom: 19,
+        attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
+      }).addTo(this.map)
+      tiles.on("tileload", () => { loaded += 1 })
+      tiles.on("tileerror", () => {
+        failed += 1
+        if (loaded === 0 && failed >= 3) this.showMapError()
+      })
+
+      this.map.on("click", (event) => {
+        const { lat, lng } = event.latlng.wrap()
+        this.setPoint(lat, lng, { reverse: true })
+      })
+
+      if (hasPoint) this.placeMarker(lat, lng)
+    } catch (error) {
+      this.showMapError()
+    }
+  }
+
+  destroyMap() {
+    try { this.map?.remove() } catch (_) { /* already gone */ }
+    this.map = null
+    this.marker = null
+  }
+
+  // ---- full screen -------------------------------------------------------
+
+  toggleFullscreen() {
+    this.fullscreen ? this.exitFullscreen() : this.enterFullscreen()
+  }
+
+  enterFullscreen() {
+    if (!this.map) return
+    this.fullscreen = true
+    Object.assign(this.mapFrameTarget.style, {
+      position: "fixed", top: "0", right: "0", bottom: "0", left: "0",
+      zIndex: "10000", background: "#fff"
+    })
+    this.mapTarget.style.height = "100%"
+    this.fullscreenButtonTarget.textContent = "Done"
+    this.fullscreenButtonTarget.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true")
+    this.fullscreenStatusTarget.hidden = false
+    this.fullscreenStatusTarget.textContent = this.statusTarget.textContent ||
+      "Click the map to drop a pin, or drag the pin. Press Done when finished."
+    this.previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow
+    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden"
+    this.onEscape = (event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") this.exitFullscreen() }
+    document.addEventListener("keydown", this.onEscape)
+    this.refreshMapSize()
+  }
+
+  exitFullscreen() {
+    this.fullscreen = false
+    this.mapFrameTarget.removeAttribute("style")
+    this.mapFrameTarget.style.position = "relative"
+    this.mapTarget.style.height = "320px"
+    this.fullscreenButtonTarget.textContent = "Full screen"
+    this.fullscreenButtonTarget.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false")
+    this.fullscreenStatusTarget.hidden = true
+    document.body.style.overflow = this.previousOverflow || ""
+    document.removeEventListener("keydown", this.onEscape)
+    this.refreshMapSize()
+  }
+
+  refreshMapSize() {
+    // Leaflet must be told when its container changes size.
+    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+      this.map?.invalidateSize()
+      if (this.marker) this.map?.panTo(this.marker.getLatLng())
+    })
+  }
+
+  showMapError() {
+    if (this.fullscreen) this.exitFullscreen()
+    this.destroyMap()
+    this.mapFrameTarget.hidden = true
+    this.mapErrorTarget.textContent = this.mapErrorMessageValue
+    this.mapErrorTarget.hidden = false
+  }
+
+  placeMarker(lat, lng) {
+    if (!this.map) return
+    if (this.marker) {
+      this.marker.setLatLng([lat, lng])
+      return
+    }
+    this.marker = L.marker([lat, lng], {
+      draggable: true,
+      keyboard: true,
+      title: "Event location (drag to adjust)"
+    }).addTo(this.map)
+    this.marker.on("dragend", () => {
+      const { lat, lng } = this.marker.getLatLng().wrap()
+      this.setPoint(lat, lng, { reverse: true })
+    })
+  }
+
+  // ---- choosing a point --------------------------------------------------
+
+  setPoint(lat, lng, { label = null, reverse = false, recenter = false } = {}) {
+    this.latitudeTarget.value = lat.toFixed(6)
+    this.longitudeTarget.value = lng.toFixed(6)
+    this.placeMarker(lat, lng)
+    if (recenter && this.map) this.map.setView([lat, lng], this.pinZoomValue)
+
+    if (label) {
+      this.nameTarget.value = label
+      this.autoNamed = true
+      this.setStatus("Location selected. Drag the pin to fine-tune it.")
+    } else if (reverse && (this.nameTarget.value.trim() === "" || this.autoNamed)) {
+      this.reverseLookup(lat, lng)
+    } else {
+      this.setStatus("Pin moved. The location name was left as you typed it.")
+    }
+  }
+
+  chooseSaved() {
+    if (!this.hasSavedTarget) return
+    const option = this.savedTarget.selectedOptions[0]
+    if (!option || !option.value) return
+    this.clearResults()
+    this.setPoint(parseFloat(option.dataset.latitude), parseFloat(option.dataset.longitude), {
+      label: option.dataset.name,
+      recenter: true
+    })
+  }
+
+  useMyLocation() {
+    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
+      this.setStatus("Your browser can't share its location. Search or use the map instead.", { error: true })
+      return
+    }
+    this.setStatus("Finding your location…")
+    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
+      (position) => {
+        this.setPoint(position.coords.latitude, position.coords.longitude, { reverse: true, recenter: true })
+      },
+      () => this.setStatus("Couldn't get your location. Search or use the map instead.", { error: true }),
+      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
+    )
+  }
+
+  nameEdited() {
+    this.autoNamed = false
+  }
+
+  // ---- search ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+  queryKeydown(event) {
+    if (event.key === "Enter") {
+      event.preventDefault()
+      this.search()
+    }
+  }
+
+  queueSearch() {
+    clearTimeout(this.timer)
+    if (this.queryTarget.value.trim().length < 3) {
+      this.clearResults()
+      return
+    }
+    this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.search(), 700)
+  }
+
+  async search(event) {
+    event?.preventDefault()
+    clearTimeout(this.timer)
+    const query = this.queryTarget.value.trim()
+    if (query.length < 3) {
+      this.setStatus("Type at least 3 characters to search.", { error: true })
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.searchAbort?.abort()
+    this.searchAbort = new AbortController()
+    this.setStatus("Searching…")
+
+    try {
+      const url = new URL(this.searchUrlValue, window.location.origin)
+      url.searchParams.set("q", query)
+      const response = await fetch(url, {
+        headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
+        signal: this.searchAbort.signal
+      })
+      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}))
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || this.searchErrorMessageValue)
+
+      if (!data.results || data.results.length === 0) {
+        this.clearResults()
+        this.setStatus(this.noResultsMessageValue, { error: true })
+        return
+      }
+      this.renderResults(data.results)
+      this.setStatus(`${data.results.length} match${data.results.length === 1 ? "" : "es"} found. Pick one to place the pin.`)
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name === "AbortError") return
+      this.clearResults()
+      this.setStatus(error.message || this.searchErrorMessageValue, { error: true })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async reverseLookup(lat, lng) {
+    this.reverseAbort?.abort()
+    this.reverseAbort = new AbortController()
+    this.setStatus("Pin placed. Looking up its address…")
+    try {
+      const url = new URL(this.searchUrlValue, window.location.origin)
+      url.searchParams.set("lat", lat)
+      url.searchParams.set("lng", lng)
+      const response = await fetch(url, {
+        headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
+        signal: this.reverseAbort.signal
+      })
+      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}))
+      const match = response.ok ? data.results?.[0] : null
+      if (match) {
+        this.nameTarget.value = match.label
+        this.autoNamed = true
+        this.setStatus("Pin placed. Edit the name below if you'd like something friendlier.")
+      } else {
+        this.setStatus("Pin placed, but no address was found. Type a name for this spot below.", { error: true })
+      }
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error.name === "AbortError") return
+      this.setStatus("Pin placed, but the address lookup failed. Type a name for this spot below.", { error: true })
+    }
+  }
+
+  renderResults(results) {
+    const items = results.map((result) => {
+      const item = document.createElement("li")
+      const button = document.createElement("button")
+      button.type = "button"
+      button.setAttribute("role", "option")
+      button.textContent = result.label // textContent: never inject provider text as HTML
+      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
+        this.clearResults()
+        this.setPoint(result.latitude, result.longitude, { label: result.label, recenter: true })
+      })
+      item.appendChild(button)
+      return item
+    })
+    this.resultsTarget.replaceChildren(...items)
+  }
+
+  clearResults() {
+    this.resultsTarget.replaceChildren()
+  }
+
+  // ---- submit guard ------------------------------------------------------
+
+  validate(event) {
+    const lat = parseFloat(this.latitudeTarget.value)
+    const lng = parseFloat(this.longitudeTarget.value)
+    const pointOk = Number.isFinite(lat) && Math.abs(lat) <= 90 &&
+                    Number.isFinite(lng) && Math.abs(lng) <= 180
+
+    if (!pointOk || this.nameTarget.value.trim() === "") {
+      event.preventDefault()
+      this.setStatus(pointOk ? this.missingNameMessageValue : this.missingLocationMessageValue, { error: true })
+      ;(pointOk ? this.nameTarget : this.queryTarget).focus()
+    }
+  }
+
+  setStatus(message, { error = false } = {}) {
+    this.statusTarget.textContent = message
+    this.statusTarget.dataset.state = error ? "error" : "info"
+    this.statusTarget.style.color = error ? "#b00020" : ""
+    if (this.fullscreen) {
+      this.fullscreenStatusTarget.textContent = message
+      this.fullscreenStatusTarget.style.color = error ? "#b00020" : ""
+    }
+  }
+}

+require "net/http"
+require "json"
+
+module Geocoding
+     class Error < StandardError; end
+
+  # Thin wrapper over OpenStreetMap's Nominatim. Called server-side so the
+  # provider can be swapped (Mapbox, Google, ...) without touching the JS, and
+  # so we can send the required User-Agent and cap request volume.
+  # Usage policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
+  class Nominatim
+       BASE_URL = "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org".freeze
+    USER_AGENT = ENV.fetch("GEOCODER_USER_AGENT", "EventLocationPicker/1.0 (set GEOCODER_USER_AGENT)").freeze
+
+    def search(query, limit: 6)
+         rows = get("/search", q: query, format: "jsonv2", limit: limit)
+      Array(rows).filter_map do |row|
+           next unless row["lat"] && row["lon"] && row["display_name"]
+        { label: row["display_name"], latitude: row["lat"].to_f, longitude: row["lon"].to_f }
+      end
+    end
+
+    def reverse(latitude, longitude)
+         row = get("/reverse", lat: latitude, lon: longitude, format: "jsonv2")
+      return nil unless row.is_a?(Hash) && row["display_name"]
+
+      { label: row["display_name"], latitude: latitude.to_f, longitude: longitude.to_f }
+    end
+
+    private
+
+         def get(path, params)
+              uri = URI("#{BASE_URL}#{path}")
+              uri.query = URI.encode_www_form(params)
+              request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
+              request["User-Agent"] = USER_AGENT
+              request["Accept"] = "application/json"
+
+              response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: true, open_timeout: 3, read_timeout: 5) do |http|
+                   http.request(request)
+              end
+              raise Error, "Geocoder responded with #{response.code}" unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
+
+              JSON.parse(response.body)
+            rescue Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout, SocketError, SystemCallError,
+                   OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError, JSON::ParserError => e
+                 raise Error, "#{e.class}: #{e.message}"
+         end
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+# Acceptance criteria for the event location picker.
+#
+# Assumptions to adjust for your app:
+#   * Uses your :member factory traits (:admin, :profile_completed) and Devise's `sign_in`.
+RSpec.describe "Event location picker", type: :request do
+     let(:officer) { create(:member, :admin, :profile_completed) }
+  let(:regular_member) { create(:member, :profile_completed) }
+  let(:geocoder) { instance_double(Geocoding::Nominatim) }
+
+  let(:valid_attributes) do
+       {
+         name: "Weekly meeting",
+         description: "Agenda",
+         starts_at: 2.days.from_now,
+         location: "Student Center, 100 Campus Dr",
+         latitude: "30.610000",
+         longitude: "-96.340000",
+         check_in_radius_meters: 100,
+         point_value: 1
+       }
+  end
+
+  let(:json_headers) { { "Accept" => "application/json" } }
+
+  before do
+       allow(Geocoding::Nominatim).to receive(:new).and_return(geocoder)
+  end
+
+  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  describe "Acceptance criterion 1 (sunny): pick a location without typing coordinates" do
+       before { sign_in(officer) }
+
+    it "suggests matching places when the officer searches" do
+         allow(geocoder).to receive(:search).with("student center").and_return(
+           [ { label: "Student Center, 100 Campus Dr", latitude: 30.61, longitude: -96.34 } ]
+         )
+
+      get location_search_events_path, params: { q: "student center" }, headers: json_headers
+
+      expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
+      expect(response.parsed_body["results"]).to contain_exactly(
+        include("label" => "Student Center, 100 Campus Dr", "latitude" => 30.61, "longitude" => -96.34)
+      )
+    end
+
+    it "gives a readable name for a pin dropped or dragged on the map" do
+         allow(geocoder).to receive(:reverse).with(30.61, -96.34)
+           .and_return({ label: "Student Center, 100 Campus Dr", latitude: 30.61, longitude: -96.34 })
+
+      get location_search_events_path, params: { lat: "30.61", lng: "-96.34" }, headers: json_headers
+
+      expect(response.parsed_body["results"].first["label"]).to eq("Student Center, 100 Campus Dr")
+    end
+
+    it "shows the map, search box and saved list, with no raw latitude/longitude inputs" do
+         SavedLocation.create!(name: "PT Clinic", latitude: 30.62, longitude: -96.33)
+
+      get new_event_path
+
+      doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
+      expect(doc.at_css('[data-controller="location-picker"]')).to be_present
+      expect(doc.at_css('[data-location-picker-target="map"]')).to be_present
+      expect(doc.at_css('[data-location-picker-target="query"]')).to be_present
+      expect(doc.at_css('option[data-name="PT Clinic"]')).to be_present
+      expect(doc.at_css('input[name="event[latitude]"]')["type"]).to eq("hidden")
+      expect(doc.at_css('input[name="event[longitude]"]')["type"]).to eq("hidden")
+    end
+
+    it "stores coordinates in the background and shows members a readable location" do
+         expect {
+              post events_path, params: { event: valid_attributes }
+         }.to change(Event, :count).by(1)
+
+      event = Event.order(:id).last
+      expect(event.location).to eq("Student Center, 100 Campus Dr")
+      expect(event.latitude.to_f).to eq(30.61)
+      expect(event.longitude.to_f).to eq(-96.34)
+
+      sign_out officer
+      sign_in regular_member
+      get event_path(event)
+      expect(response.body).to include("Student Center, 100 Campus Dr")
+      expect(response.body).not_to include("30.61")
+    end
+
+    it "can add the chosen spot to the commonly used list" do
+         expect {
+              post events_path, params: { event: valid_attributes, save_as_location: "1" }
+         }.to change(SavedLocation, :count).by(1)
+
+      expect(SavedLocation.last.name).to eq("Student Center, 100 Campus Dr")
+    end
+  end
+
+  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+  describe "Acceptance criterion 2 (rainy): clear messages and never a bad location" do
+       context "as an officer" do
+            before { sign_in(officer) }
+
+         it "reports a search with no results as an empty list the picker turns into a clear message" do
+              allow(geocoder).to receive(:search).and_return([])
+
+           get location_search_events_path, params: { q: "zzzzzz" }, headers: json_headers
+
+           expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
+           expect(response.parsed_body["results"]).to eq([])
+
+           get new_event_path
+           expect(response.body).to include("No locations found, try a different search.")
+         end
+
+         it "returns a friendly error, not a stack trace, when the geocoder is down" do
+              allow(geocoder).to receive(:search).and_raise(Geocoding::Error, "timeout")
+
+           get location_search_events_path, params: { q: "student center" }, headers: json_headers
+
+           expect(response).to have_http_status(:service_unavailable)
+           expect(response.parsed_body["error"]).to match(/Choose from the list or try again later/)
+         end
+
+         it "rejects a too-short search without calling the geocoder" do
+              expect(geocoder).not_to receive(:search)
+
+           get location_search_events_path, params: { q: "ab" }, headers: json_headers
+
+           expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
+           expect(response.parsed_body["error"]).to match(/at least 3 characters/)
+         end
+
+         it "ships a clear map-failure message and keeps the saved list available" do
+              SavedLocation.create!(name: "PT Clinic", latitude: 30.62, longitude: -96.33)
+
+           get new_event_path
+
+           expect(response.body).to include(
+             "The map could not be loaded. Choose from the list or try again later."
+           )
+           expect(Nokogiri::HTML(response.body).at_css('option[data-name="PT Clinic"]')).to be_present
+         end
+
+         it "does not save an event with no location selected" do
+              attrs = valid_attributes.merge(location: "", latitude: "", longitude: "")
+
+           expect { post events_path, params: { event: attrs } }.not_to change(Event, :count)
+
+           expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
+           expect(response.body).to include("Choose a location on the map before saving.")
+         end
+
+         it "does not save an event with a pin but no readable name" do
+              attrs = valid_attributes.merge(location: "")
+
+           expect { post events_path, params: { event: attrs } }.not_to change(Event, :count)
+           expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
+         end
+
+         it "does not save incorrect coordinates" do
+              [
+                { latitude: "91", longitude: "-96.34" },
+                { latitude: "30.61", longitude: "-181" },
+                { latitude: "abc", longitude: "-96.34" }
+              ].each do |bad|
+                   expect {
+                        post events_path, params: { event: valid_attributes.merge(bad) }
+                   }.not_to change(Event, :count)
+              end
+         end
+
+         it "does not let an edit wipe out an existing location" do
+              event = Event.create!(valid_attributes)
+
+           patch event_path(event), params: { event: { location: "", latitude: "", longitude: "" } }
+
+           expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
+           event.reload
+           expect(event.location).to eq("Student Center, 100 Campus Dr")
+           expect(event.latitude.to_f).to eq(30.61)
+         end
+       end
+
+    context "as a regular member (officers only)" do
+         before { sign_in(regular_member) }
+
+      it "cannot use location search" do
+           expect(geocoder).not_to receive(:search)
+
+        get location_search_events_path, params: { q: "student center" }, headers: json_headers
+
+        expect(response).to have_http_status(:forbidden)
+      end
+
+      it "cannot open the form or create an event" do
+           get new_event_path
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(events_path)
+
+        expect {
+             post events_path, params: { event: valid_attributes }
+        }.not_to change(Event, :count)
+      end
+
+      it "cannot change an event's location" do
+           event = Event.create!(valid_attributes)
+
+        patch event_path(event), params: { event: { location: "Elsewhere", latitude: "1", longitude: "1" } }
+
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(events_path)
+        expect(event.reload.location).to eq("Student Center, 100 Campus Dr")
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end
